subject: same app and code, but different result depending on URL and port

messages.author: b4e76ba6d40254bf
messages.subject: same app and code, but different result depending on URL and port
parts:
Odd situation here.  I've set my own shiny server on an Ubuntu 14.04 server.  I'm trying to just get the basic sample app to run.  When I launch the app from within the RStudio Server IDE, it renders properly and comes through on port 3838.  When I access the app from the url, I get a different result, one with no color.  It's hard to explain, and easier to just look at:

http://shiny.benporter.io/ben/sample/

I really think it's something with my server config, and not the actual ui.R or server.R files.  Here is my /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf file. Any ideas on where to go first?

ben@shinyserver:/etc/shiny-server$ cat shiny-server.conf 

# Tell Shiny Server that we want to run as the user whose 
# home directory we find the application in.
run_as :HOME_USER:;

# Define a server that listens of port 3838.
server {
  listen 80;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {
    
    # Allow users to host their own apps in ~/ShinyApps
    user_dirs;

    # Optionally, you can restrict the privilege of hosting Shiny applications
    # only to members of a particular Linux group.
    # members_of shinyUsers;
  }
}


Side note and potential root cause, I've disabled apache to prevent the port 80 conflict.  I've run this on my server:

sudo update-rc.d apache2 disable

parts:
I'm not sure if this can help, but I've noticed that my rstudio and shiny servers were having a few small issues and it seemed that telling nginx to proxy websockets fixed it.

I wrote a blog post about setting up shiny server and there's a small section on doing this
http://deanattali.com/2015/05/09/setup-rstudio-shiny-server-digital-ocean/#reverse-proxy

There's a good chance this isn't the problem , but maaaaybe it is :)
